{{Otheruses|Algarian}}
The '''Algarian Bureaucracy''' was the government of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Algara II]]. As every aspect of [[Algarian (race)|Algarian]] life was maintained by a Bureau, it was difficult to identify a single individual as the head of the government. Each bureau answered to the [[Bureau of Revenue]], which was made up of one member from each of the Bureaus.
